## Academic Context

Ratiomera is a free, volunteer-built educational platform for mathematics and statistics. Ratiomera Statistics currently supports students and professionals across the humanities and social sciences at university level. No institutional endorsement, accreditation, or formal affiliation is claimed.

## Usage Counters

The visible visit and download fields are currently disabled placeholders. Ratiomera does not currently send requests to a counter provider or record usage through one. Page-visit counts, if enabled later, will represent page loads rather than unique people. Download counts will only display values supplied by the configured file provider.

Before an external counter provider is enabled, this notice will be updated with the provider, the information sent, and the applicable retention and privacy details.

---

## Hosting and Privacy

Ratiomera is delivered as a static website through GitHub Pages. GitHub states that when a GitHub Pages site is visited, the visitor's IP address is logged and stored for security purposes, whether or not the visitor is signed in. GitHub processes information associated with its service under the [GitHub General Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). Ratiomera does not operate a separate visitor database or receive GitHub's raw Pages IP logs through this website.

The current Ratiomera site code does not enable an analytics service, advertising tracker, visitor account system, contact form, or remote visit and download counter. If this changes, the relevant notice will be updated before the feature is enabled.

When someone contacts Ratiomera by email, the sender address, message content, attachments, and technical delivery information are processed through Cyon's email hosting so that the message can be received, sorted, protected against abuse, and answered. Access is limited to volunteers who need the correspondence for those purposes. Messages are retained only for as long as reasonably needed to handle the inquiry and any resulting obligations. Cyon provides information about its processing and Swiss data location in its [privacy information](https://www.cyon.ch/ueber-cyon/datenschutz).

Please do not send sensitive personal information, confidential student records, or unpublished assessment material. Questions about Ratiomera's handling of personal data can be sent to [{{< var contact.informatics >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.informatics >}}).
